$comment: SHARED ACROSS THREE REPOSITORIES. Captured from Engine\SceneComposer::compose() by running it, not written by hand — the same discipline assignment-wire.json records. Byte-identical copies live in optioniaWooCommercePlugin/tests/fixtures/shared/, optioniaWooCommerceBackend/test/fixtures/shared/ and optioniaWooCommerceFrontend/test/fixtures/shared/, all gated by check-fixture-parity.sh.
$why: The plugin composes this shape in PHP; buildScene() consumes it in TypeScript. That contract lived in two languages with NO mechanical link, and it broke: both the render worker and POST /store/preview passed the composed scene straight to sceneToSvgString(), which wants images/texts already resolved to pixels rather than layers/textOptions in fractions. Every real designed order threw and dead-lettered while 1,333 e2e tests passed, because every fixture had been written in the RESOLVED shape — describing the serializer's input rather than the composer's output. Found by rendering one job on a live worker, which returned a valid 600x600 PNG with nothing drawn on it.
